r2 of the THIRD image in the /pages/brightening-glow set - templates/page.brightening-glow.json, section `content`, block `together` ('The Multi-Pathway Brightening System'). It currently wears a serum dropper photograph.

=== WHY r1 IS BEING RE-RUN, BECAUSE IT WAS THE BRIEF'S FAULT ===

r1 said 'The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge'. Every engine obeyed: 17 of 20 candidates came back with the block clipped by both frame edges. A clipped block HAS NO END FACES, so when it is later narrowed to match its two published siblings the strata terminate in a flat vertical slice - which Malcolm rejected on the causes frame on 2026-08-26. Modelled ends are geometry, not a filter; no post-processing invents them. Hence the inversion below. Same reason the bead scale is now specified: the published causes frame (nbp_pro_01) has a finer granular band than its partner and the two do not quite read as one render.

=== WHAT THIS FRAME MUST ARGUE - ALL THREE, SIMULTANEOUSLY ===

The copy lists three things and says they happen 'at the same time'. Each gets its own depth in the block so all three are visible at once and none reads as a stage in a sequence:

  1 EVEN-LOOKING TONE   -> the granular band, where the warm-brown pigment granules are spread in a perfectly EVEN regular scatter, never clustered. Evenness is the whole point, and it is what separates this frame from the causes frame two rows above, where the same granules are gathered into blotches.
  2 ANTIOXIDANT DEFENCE -> the air above the surface, where descending grey free-radical motes break apart and fade as the actives arrive.
  3 HYDRATION & GLOW    -> the surface itself, plumped and taut, holding clear water droplets, with a crisp specular highlight that makes the block reflect light.

IT MUST NOT DEPICT PIGMENT BEING DESTROYED, lifted, bleached or erased. 'Even-looking tone' here means the pigment is evenly DISTRIBUTED, not removed - the same quantity, spread evenly instead of clumped. Skin-lightening imagery would overclaim what the copy says and contradict the page's own FAQ answering 'Is glutathione safe for all skin tones?'. No face appears, so no tone comparison is possible.

NO LEFT-TO-RIGHT PROGRESSION. A gradient across the block reads as 'this end became that end', which is a before-and-after wearing a gradient - the trap caught on the firming pair. The block is uniform across its width; the three events are separated by DEPTH, not by side.

=== THE ACTIVES, TOLD APART BY FORM, NEVER BY COLOUR ===

Glutathione is a tripeptide: a chain of EXACTLY THREE pearl-white beads, three and no more. Tetrapeptide-1 is four beads. Nonapeptide-1 is a longer chain of about nine. Stable vitamin C is a single small colourless faceted crystal, because ascorbic acid is crystalline. Nothing is tinted and nothing is metallic - the only bright thing in the frame is the warm white light of the delivery. GHK-Cu is deliberately NOT drawn as copper: metallic copper is barred on this store's anatomy diagrams and would read as a brand colour.

=== GEOMETRY, MEASURED LIVE 2026-08-26 ===

The `together` block's media box is 660x660 at 1440 - SQUARE, unlike the causes block's 660x730. So the master is square 2048x2048 and renders uncropped. The two already-published frames put their block at 0.7905 of the frame width; this one must match, which is why the block is specified as about four fifths of the width with modelled ends rather than filling the frame.

CLASS B, no reference images - every selected explainer on this store was generated class B with the style carried in the prompt. All six suppliers, two candidates each. FLUX.2 renders printed graduation digits on anything glassware-like and there is a glass base plate here, so check its candidates at full size for numbers. Remember `set -a` before sourcing credentials.

slots.title: A · Full stack, the three benefits at three depths, block inset with modelled ends
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key, lit with soft even diffuse light. Square format. Warm generic skin tones throughout - peach, blush, cream and pale pink - on a smooth warm cream background gradient, faintly glowing.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, the cut face exactly parallel to the picture plane, edges horizontal. The top surface is not seen as a plane - at most the thinnest sliver shows along its upper edge.

THE BLOCK DOES NOT TOUCH THE SIDES OF THE FRAME. It sits inset, occupying about four fifths of the frame's width, with clear empty background to its left and to its right. ITS LEFT AND RIGHT ENDS ARE FULLY MODELLED AND VISIBLE: every layer finishes in a rounded, three-dimensional end face rather than a flat slice - the packed spheres end as whole rounded spheres, the thin plates end with a softly rounded edge that shows their thickness, the cables end in smooth closed rounded tips, and the deep lobules bulge outward as complete rounded forms. The block stands on a thin clear glass plate that extends a little beyond it at both ends.

THE STACK, TOP TO BOTTOM: a quilted surface of soft rounded pads; a thin cream film of fine parallel strands; a thick band of packed rounded spheres; a thin peach plate; a zone of pearl-ivory cables lying in loose horizontal waves; a second peach plate; two rows of large cream-blush lobules. THE PACKED SPHERES IN THAT BAND ARE LARGE AND CLEARLY SEPARATE - each one a distinct glossy rounded ball, generously sized so individual spheres read easily. They are not fine sand, not powder, not tiny grains.

THREE THINGS ARE HAPPENING AT ONCE, AT THREE DIFFERENT DEPTHS, ACROSS THE WHOLE WIDTH OF THE BLOCK:

AT THE SURFACE: the quilted pads are swollen, plump, taut and glossy, pressed close together with no gaps. Held within them and just beneath them are clear colourless glassy water droplets in three distinct sizes, small, medium and large. A crisp bright specular highlight runs along the top of the plumped surface so the block visibly reflects light.

IN THE AIR ABOVE: six large glassy transparent spheres float in the hazy air, each one holding either a short chain of exactly three pearl-white beads, or a chain of four beads, or a longer chain of about nine beads, or a single small colourless faceted crystal. Fine dark grey angular motes drift downward toward the surface, and WHERE THEY MEET THE SPHERES AND THE WARM WHITE LIGHT AROUND THEM THEY BREAK APART AND FADE, dissolving into nothing before they reach the skin. A few slender beams of warm white light descend from the spheres into the surface layers, with a small soft glint where each one lands.

IN THE BAND OF PACKED SPHERES: soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules are scattered in a completely EVEN, regular, uniform distribution - spaced apart from one another, the same everywhere from one end of the block to the other. They are never gathered into clusters, blotches or dark patches anywhere.

The block is uniform across its width - no end of it is healthier or duller than the other. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.
